A group of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] ventured onto the [[Rryatt Trail]] — a long and winding trail through the dense [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyykian]] forests during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They set up a small camp on the [[Rryatt Trail#Wroshyr Canopy|Wroshyr Canopy]] level of the trail when they got lost and couldn't find their way back.

The camp consisted of several primitive tents made out of wood and hide. When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found the camp in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the tents were collapsed and destroyed.
